title: Settings
description: Switches and limits that take effect from the next request, without a restart.
readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.
empty: There are no settings to show.
refreshFailed: Could not refresh the latest settings — showing the version loaded earlier.
saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
integerRange: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
vetoedNote: Turned off by the server configuration; the stored value applies once it is lifted.
degradedNote: The settings store is unavailable, so a safe fallback applies.

lowerValue.title: Lower the versions kept?
lowerValue.message: Lowering from {{from}} to {{to}} removes each project's older versions beyond {{to}} at its next save. They cannot be restored.

deletionConditions.title: Account deletion conditions
deletionConditions.description: A member cannot request deletion while an enabled condition below applies to them. The message is shown to the member in their language.
deletionConditions.loadFailed: Could not load the account deletion conditions.
deletionConditions.empty: There are no account deletion conditions to show.

source.VETOED: Turned off by the server configuration

project_max_versions.label: Versions kept per project
project_max_versions.help: Older versions beyond this number are removed when a project is saved. 1 to 200.

project_max_bytes.label: Largest project document (bytes)
project_max_bytes.help: The editor refuses to save a project document larger than this. 100000 to 10000000 bytes.

batch_max_items.label: Scenes per batch
batch_max_items.help: The editor refuses an AI batch or scene split with more scenes than this. 1 to 12.

take_check_daily_max.label: Take checks per member per day
take_check_daily_max.help: A member who has used this many take checks today is refused until the next Vietnam day. 1 to 200.

stems_max_duration_sec.label: Longest clip for voice and music separation (seconds)
stems_max_duration_sec.help: The editor refuses to separate voice and music from a clip longer than this. 60 to 3600 seconds.

speakers_max_duration_sec.label: Longest clip for speaker separation (seconds)
speakers_max_duration_sec.help: The editor refuses to separate speakers in a clip longer than this. 60 to 1800 seconds.

derive_max_duration_sec.label: Longest clip for deriving a version (seconds)
derive_max_duration_sec.help: The editor refuses to derive a new clip from a source longer than this. 10 to 3600 seconds.

beats_max_duration_sec.label: Longest clip for beat analysis (seconds)
beats_max_duration_sec.help: The editor refuses to analyse the beats of a clip longer than this. 30 to 1200 seconds.

audio_tools_max_duration_sec.label: Longest track for audio tools (seconds)
audio_tools_max_duration_sec.help: The editor refuses to extract the audio of a track longer than this. 60 to 14400 seconds.

enabled.label: Members can request account deletion
enabled.help: Turning it off stops new requests; requests already made keep their deadline. Nothing is erased at the deadline until the erasure step ships.

grace_period_days.label: Days to change one's mind
grace_period_days.help: A member can cancel until this many days after requesting. Each request keeps the period that applied when it was made. 1 to 365 days.

enabled.label: Password reset
enabled.help: Turning it off hides the reset link for members and refuses reset requests from the next request.

enabled.label: Run cancellation
enabled.help: Turning it off hides the Stop button for members and refuses cancel requests from the next request.

enabled.label: Help Center
enabled.help: Turning it off hides the Help Center for members and refuses every Help Center request from the next request.

enabled.label: AI assistant
enabled.help: Turning it off takes effect from the next question; guide articles and requests keep working.

daily_ceiling.label: Questions per day, all askers
daily_ceiling.help: The assistant pauses for the day once this many questions were answered.

member_daily_quota.label: Questions per member per day
member_daily_quota.help: How many questions one signed-in member may ask each day.

guest_daily_quota.label: Questions per guest per day
guest_daily_quota.help: How many questions one guest may ask each day.

guest_network_daily_quota.label: Questions per guest network per day
guest_network_daily_quota.help: How many questions all guests behind one network address may ask each day.

enabled.label: Auto-close resolved requests
enabled.help: Closes a resolved request when the member neither replies nor confirms it in time.

resolved_days.label: Days before a resolved request closes
resolved_days.help: Counted from when the member first opened the resolved request. 1 to 90 days.

enabled.label: Email members about replies
enabled.help: Sends the member one email when an admin replies. While it is off, replies wait and are mailed once it is turned back on.

window_minutes.label: Minutes to group replies into one email
window_minutes.help: Replies sent within this window reach the member as one email. 0 sends right away; at most 1440 minutes.

enabled.label: Delete old closed requests
enabled.help: Permanently deletes closed requests, with their messages and images, once they are older than the retention period. Other statuses are never deleted.

closed_request_months.label: Months to keep a closed request
closed_request_months.help: Counted from the request's last activity. 6 to 120 months.

enabled.label: Alert admins about late requests
enabled.help: Rings the admin bell when a request becomes due soon or overdue. The inbox keeps showing each request's level while it is off.

new_hours.label: Hours before a new request is overdue
new_hours.help: Counted from the request's last activity. 1 to 720 hours. A warning at or above this limit means no "due soon" level.

new_warn_hours.label: Hours before a new request is due soon
new_warn_hours.help: Counted from the request's last activity. 1 to 720 hours. At or above the limit, "due soon" never shows.

in_progress_days.label: Days before an in-progress request is overdue
in_progress_days.help: Counted from the request's last activity. 1 to 90 days. A warning at or above this limit means no "due soon" level.

in_progress_warn_days.label: Days before an in-progress request is due soon
in_progress_warn_days.help: Counted from the request's last activity. 1 to 90 days. At or above the limit, "due soon" never shows.
